scripts.seed: npm run build -w @defchain/shared && npm run seed -w @defchain/agency-adapter
scripts.dev:lite: cross-env FABRIC_NETWORK_MODE=lite concurrently -k -n api,rab,web -c cyan,magenta,blue "npm run dev -w @defchain/gateway-api" "npm run dev:rab -w @defchain/agency-adapter" "npm run dev -w @defchain/web"
scripts.dev:full: cross-env FABRIC_NETWORK_MODE=full concurrently -k -n api,rab,bgb,customs,web -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green,blue "npm run dev -w @defchain/gateway-api" "npm run dev:rab -w @defchain/agency-adapter" "npm run dev:bgb -w @defchain/agency-adapter" "npm run dev:customs -w @defchain/agency-adapter" "npm run dev -w @defchain/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @defchain/shared && npm run build -w @defchain/fabric-client && npm run build -w @defchain/chaincode && npm run build -w @defchain/agency-adapter && npm run build -w @defchain/gateway-api && npm run build -w @defchain/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @defchain/shared && npm run typecheck -w @defchain/fabric-client && npm run typecheck -w @defchain/chaincode && npm run typecheck -w @defchain/agency-adapter && npm run typecheck -w @defchain/gateway-api && npm run typecheck -w @defchain/web
scripts.lint: eslint apps services packages blockchain tests --ext .ts,.tsx
scripts.test: npm run test -w @defchain/shared && npm run test -w @defchain/chaincode && npm run test -w @defchain/agency-adapter && npm run test -w @defchain/gateway-api && npm run test -w @defchain/web
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && bash scripts/verify-ledger-leakage.sh
